description: Divide the codebase into slices, review concurrently, build a dependency-aware refactoring task DAG, implement ready disjoint tasks in shared-workspace waves, reconcile and review each wave, and repeat until complete.

prompts.rielaPromptTemplate: Coordinate {{workflowId}}. Start by slicing the codebase. Dispatch read-only slice reviews through bounded fanout. Merge review results into a deduplicated refactoring plan. Treat duplicate-scavenge as an additive mode when workflowInput.refactoringMode or freeform requestedOutcome/constraints request it, and let each step prompt own its phase-specific duplicate guidance. If workflowInput.executionMode requests plan-only, finish after plan creation. Otherwise implement exactly one ready plan task per implementation pass, complete its integrated author self-check, then run an independent post-refactor review. Route back to implementation when high or mid findings remain. If the task is accepted and the plan still has ready tasks, continue with the next task. Finish only when the plan is complete, blocked, or only accepted low residual risks remain. Do not stage, commit, push, or revert unrelated dirty worktree changes.
prompts.workerSystemPromptTemplate: Return concise business JSON only. Keep slice ids, plan ids, task ids, changed files, verification commands, review findings, routing flags, blockers, and residual risks explicit.

steps.description: Divide the codebase into bounded package or processing-group review slices.
Merge concurrent slice-review results into a deduplicated, dependency-aware refactoring plan.
Implement exactly one ready refactoring task from the merged plan.
Independently review the latest refactoring task and decide whether to revise, continue, or finish.
Publish final refactoring plan, implementation status, verification evidence, and residual risks.

rielaPackage.title: codex-refactoring-divide-and-conquer
rielaPackage.description: Review codebase slices concurrently, then implement dependency-ready refactoring tasks in bounded shared-workspace fanout waves with serial reconciliation.
